implemented: Jobs exposes a separate ATS selector for Greenhouse and the synthetic mock provider; the existing Source filter remains independent.

ATS identity matching reuses fail-closed resolver behavior: missing evidence, route-only/source-only providers, mismatched tenant, low confidence, and ambiguous same-provider/same-tenant identities do not qualify.
The ATS facet composes with existing direct Jobs criteria using AND.
Saved searches validate supported ATS values, save/restore/clear the facet per profile, and default legacy payloads to empty.
Connected Chromium verified exact Greenhouse inclusion, qualified synthetic mock selection, fail-closed route cases, saved-search reload/restore/clear and profile isolation.
Filtering causes no discovery schedule, application mutation, or submission side effect.
